examples.text: Простите, я вас совсем не понимаю.
examples.trans: Excuse me, I do not understand you at all.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Да, дежурный повёл их прямо наверх.
examples.trans: Yes, the receptionist led them straight upstairs.

examples.text: Прости, это я сама его спрятала.
examples.trans: Forgive me, I hid it myself.

examples.text: Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: Just like that?

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'верх').

examples.text: Я сам их встречу, бегом наверх!
examples.trans: I will meet them myself, run upstairs!

examples.text: Да, дежурный повёл их прямо наверх.
examples.trans: Yes, the receptionist led them straight upstairs.

examples.text: Он там наверху с другими девушками гуляет!
examples.trans: He is fooling around upstairs with other girls!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Тебе ещё не надоела серая Москва?
examples.trans: Are you not tired of gray Moscow yet?

examples.text: Нам сейчас срочно надо идти на улицу.
examples.trans: We urgently need to go outside right now.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'рочно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Нам сейчас срочно надо идти на улицу.
examples.trans: We urgently need to go outside right now.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

examples.text: Надо срочно спасать наш ресторан!
examples.trans: We must urgently save our restaurant!

meanings.en: to save, to rescue from danger
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пасать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to save', paired with 'спасти'.

examples.text: Надо срочно спасать наш ресторан!
examples.trans: We must urgently save our restaurant!

examples.text: Все прибежали тебя спасать — и я, и папа!
examples.trans: Everyone came running to save you — both me and Dad!

examples.text: Врачи спасают жизни каждый день.
examples.trans: Doctors save lives every day.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'our', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Пусть сам смотрит нашу столицу.
examples.trans: Let him tour our capital on his own.

examples.text: Настя, неси сюда нашу заначку.
examples.trans: Nastya, bring our secret cash stash here.

examples.text: Надо срочно спасать наш ресторан!
examples.trans: We must urgently save our restaurant!

meanings.note: Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.text: Вы те два клоуна из ресторана?
examples.trans: Are you those two clowns from the restaurant?

examples.text: Надо срочно спасать наш ресторан!
examples.trans: We must urgently save our restaurant!

examples.text: А я напишу хороший отчёт о ресторане.
examples.trans: And I will write a good report about the restaurant.
